title.zh: 共振 · 踩中节拍，小推也能荡高
title.en: Resonance · Push in Time and a Small Force Goes a Long Way

desc.zh: 从弹簧的固有节拍出发，看阻尼怎样让振动衰减，再看周期性的推力在什么频率下把振幅推到最高。
desc.en: Start from a spring’s natural beat, see how damping makes oscillations die away, then find the driving frequency at which periodic pushes build the largest swing.
